options.label: Kuro swimwear
options.note: Compact bun retained after the first shape produced a ponytail. The new central fringe is more pointed than the current blunt fringe. Animation approval is separate: native walk/run; corrected relaxed idle; static review seat pose. Not installed.

options.label: Emi swimwear
options.note: Closest facial match in the independent clothing review. Teal sports one-piece; native model and texture. Animation approval is separate: native walk/run; corrected relaxed idle; static review seat pose. Not installed.

options.label: Eric swimwear
options.note: Seated rig defect remains: triangular calf/ankle flap and flattened far foot. Navy swim shorts. Eyes are rounder and the jaw/stubble broader than the current model. The first arm retarget was rejected and is retained in history. Animation approval is separate: native walk/run; corrected relaxed idle; static review seat pose. Not installed.

options.label: Carina swimwear
options.note: Seated rig defect remains: smaller calf flap and broad foot. Burgundy sports one-piece. Equal-height head/hair comparison checked against the current corrected model. The front hair edge is straighter, and bare feet are broad/blocky. Animation approval is separate: native walk/run; corrected relaxed idle; static review seat pose. Not installed.
